scope: three R23 direct callees; selected normal branches, not a complete transitive native predicate

normal_observations: Before call 3d79f0, copies incoming R8 to saved RBX, RDX to R10, RCX to R9. R23 supplied R8D=0, actor full handle in RDX and target country pointer in RCX.
Calls 3d79f0 at 2f159f. Copies its RAX result to R11; null selects 2f160b where AL is cleared, but that exit's epilogue is not fully decoded.

On nonnull result U, compares byte U+0x11a with zero and loads QWORD [R9+0x20]. R9/R10 were copied before the external call; their preservation/contract by that callee has not been independently closed.

If U+0x11a is nonzero, resolves the signed16 slot of the [R9+0x20] value through the country table, reads that country's +0x18f0 handle and compares only its slot word with R10's slot word. Equality selects the unclosed false exit.
Otherwise calls b1e020 with RCX=U+0x1c8, RDX=current value loaded from [R9+0x20], R8=R10, R9=saved incoming R8. This is an observed register assignment, not a guessed C++ class/signature.
AL nonzero from b1e020 selects 2f160b; AL zero reaches 2f1603 setting AL=1 and the fully selected normal RET at 2f160a.
known_return_subsets: normal true path sets AL=1 and reaches RET 2f160a
false branch clears AL at 2f160b but remaining epilogue is not closed
unknowns: callee effects, return contracts and R9/R10 preservation
business identity of U/+11a/+1c8 or country+18f0
complete false exit and exception behavior

normal_observations: At 40a6d6 reads P=QWORD [RCX+0x1420]. R23 supplied the country resolved from its linked handle.

For P nonnull, 40a6e2 reads QWORD [P+0x10], then 40a6f3 overwrites RAX with P+0x38 and returns at 40a6fc. The P+0x10 read still occurs even though that loaded value does not determine this branch's final result.
For P null, calls 798dc0 at 40a6e8. A nonnull RAX becomes RAX+0x78 and returns at 40a70b.
If that result is null, calls 7a73c0 at 40a70c, adds 0x58 to its RAX and returns at 40a71a. There is no later nonnull validation in this function.
known_return_subsets: P nonnull: P+0x38 with no external call on that selected branch
P null: return depends on unreviewed fallback callees
unknowns: business type/identity/ownership of P and all three returned interior addresses
fallback effects, allocation, lifetime and failure behavior
does not prove that any returned pointer is safely callable/readable outside its native context

normal_observations: Reads P=QWORD [RCX+0x188]. RCX is the returned address from 40a6d0 in R23; P's type/name is not established.

P nonnull path reads DWORD [P]. EDX receives that DWORD if its sign bit is clear, otherwise its bitwise complement; it does not simply compute an absolute value. R8D retains the original DWORD for call 7b3950.

Reads a byte at current RSP+0x70 after push RBX/sub RSP,0x60, i.e. entry RSP+8, and copies it to outgoing/local stack+0x28. Its origin and purpose are unknown; it is not labeled a defined argument or an uninitialized value.
Calls 7b3950, then sets RCX=returned RAX+8 and RDX to RIP-derived 0x232e9c8 before calling 1a3514c. That data address was not read; its content and the callee's business operation are unknown.
Zero EAX from 1a3514c calls 45b6e0(P). Nonnull result feeds the selected byte-return path; null selects an initialization path whose tail is outside the window.
P null or nonzero EAX from 1a3514c selects address 0x1c38150 via LEA. Its byte content was not read and is not assumed false.

At 7ae2be reads a byte from the selected RAX address and zero-extends it into EAX, then returns at 7ae2c6. This is a byte return; strict boolean normalization is not proved. R23 only tests AL for zero/nonzero.
The null 45b6e0 result path zeroes 24 local stack bytes at current RSP+0x40..+0x57 and calls 45b260 with RCX=&local buffer. No subsequent instruction is in the permitted window.
known_return_subsets: 7ae2c6 returns EAX=zero-extended byte read through selected pointer
unknowns: unread data/literal content and pointed object types
callee side effects, caching, allocation, failure and lifetime
unread 10B tail and complete return behavior

implication_for_observation: R23's direct actor-to-target cache flag remains a separate bounded observation. It must not be advertised as the complete 506d70 result.
The linked path goes through conditional evaluator calls and an interior-address selector with fallback calls. The available prefixes do not establish a transitive read-only native predicate.
No +0x18f0, +0x1420, +0x188, +0x11a or +0x1c8 business class name is assigned; in particular no overlord/tributary inference is used.
The windows expose no proven truce typed index, expiry/date unit, removed flag, full-object ownership or peace-request causal completion proof.
No helper invocation, process read, reader implementation or extension of native readiness follows from these static records.
